desc: Play as Luigi: every boot and hammer move of Mario's in the field, as Mario does them (the same input and motions for each pick: playas_moves_mario, _luigi, _peach, _bowser): the Spin Jump, the Spring Jump and its launch (also as a person plays them: A held from take-off, a thumb's analog spin, a jump on the move), the Ultra Hammer's spin, the hammer, Yoshi's ride and getting off, Paper and Tube Mode
log_must: ^\[input\] frame \d+: where spin_jump\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 16,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where spring_jump\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 20,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where spring_jump_up\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ [1-9]\d\d -?\d+, .*motion 20,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where spring_jump_thumb\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 20,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where spring_jump_thumb_launch\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ (2[6-9]|[3-9]\d|[1-9]\d\d) -?\d+, .*motion 20,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where spring_jump_moving_mid\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ 25 -?\d+, .*motion \d+,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where spin_jump_thumb\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 16,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where hammer_spin\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 19,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where hammer\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 18,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where yoshi\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 26,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where yoshi_off\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 0,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where paper\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 21,
^\[input\] frame \d+: where tube\s*\n\[input\] where: map 'hei_00', Mario at -?\d+ \d+ -?\d+, .*motion 22,
